new.description: shapes hydrate; starter() composes; options override

summary: The SDK's starter subpath ships the mechanics shapes (gate hooks, typecheck, harness reference, counsel rule) as typed constructors, and starter() composes them with defaults
acceptance: import { starter } from '@dtmd/temper/starter' composes into a harness that emits the gates, the typecheck and the reference; pnpm --dir sdk test green
notes: SDK-only behavior: the SDK gate holds it, no cargo line. Reuse gateHook, tool, reference and the counsel rule rather than restating them. The patterns are a separate entry; a pattern's required parameter has no default, so starter() takes it as a typed option and composes it only when given. Telemetry stays opt-in.
